preregistration.purpose: Quantify available2..6 nodes and mean pair spacing; record actual nodes used per fix, error, coverage and suspect flags. No new algorithm or confidence fitting.
preregistration.limits: One fixed single-source free-field site, two noise/hardware seeds. Ring geometry changes with count at fixed mean pair spacing. Added nodes do not keep all earlier positions fixed. Report paired seed values/ranges, not a robust population95%CI or a forced third-node benefit. Retained fusion still selects pairs.
preregistration.population: All60 cases required. Never pool this single flat4 design with the distinct12-mic variance population to rank arrays.
